scope: Read-only projection analysis. No UI, plan, renderer, asset or V6 changes.

findings.composition: Portrait is separately composited, not a crop/resize of the finished native frame.

foreground.precision: Geometric pixel-centre mapping; resampling/compression edge uncertainty below the magnitude of the reported layout differences.

findings.savedGeometry: Native and portrait store independent coordinates, sizes, angles and taper. They are not derived from a shared table plane.
findings.comparison: flatQuad derives a projective comparison separately from each view's P4.C1; heading 0 degrees is in-plane direction, not camera/table pitch.
findings.comparisonPersistence: Flat-plane checkbox and heading are not fields in schemaVersion 1; Exportera jämförelse freezes displayed corners separately.

native.meaning: Implied by the comparison formula; not a measured camera horizon.

portrait.meaning: Implied by the comparison formula; not a measured camera horizon.

mappingBasis.pointType: Planned native target centres and contours from the frozen user export, not measured or approved film/hand contacts.
mappingBasis.conditionalAssumption: The planned native targets are hypothetically used with the current V6 foreground transform.
mappingBasis.distanceMeaning: Distance between that hypothetical transformed native target and the independently saved portrait target.
mappingBasis.conditionalResult: Under this assumption, target differences are approximately 357-541 px and the planned P1/P7 contours would be clipped. Actual future film landings are not established by this calculation.

recommendation.firstShot: Use the frozen native target/corners as a planned visual 2D reference only, keeping source camera fixed. Measure actual landing and hand contact in the accepted source clip afterward. Do not treat heading 0 as calibrated table tilt or assume planned native and saved portrait targets coincide.
minimumLaterChange: Keep logical card positions, in-plane yaw and physical card dimensions in one table plane.
Use an explicitly versioned projection per view; initially preserve current native reference and derive contact-sensitive portrait overlay from the SAME foreground transform.

If the frozen native targets are used with the current foreground transform, the planned P1/P7 contours would be clipped. Test mobile framing/composition against all seven planned targets before relying on that mapping; actual film contact remains clip-specific.
Use at least four matching non-collinear table-plane anchors per view to estimate planar mappings; camera pitch in degrees requires additional camera/metric constraints.
Treat film-contact/mask data separately from table artwork, card bend and gloss. Do not stretch cards by the current portrait felt-texture resize.
recommendation.deployment: Analysis only. No automatic conversion or migration implemented.
